channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Gorgui Dieng | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Gorgui Dieng from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Gorgui Dieng
item.description:
Pop on Gorgui Dieng:

“He's our veteran, so to speak. Great, great teammate. Everybody responds to him, commands respect very quickly. Great sense of humor and when he speaks he says things that matter, so he's been really good.”

Gregg Popovich on Gorgui Dieng, Nov 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealTomPetrini.

item.title: Travis Schlenk on Gorgui Dieng
item.description:
JD Shaw:The Hawks have officially signed center Gorgui Dieng.

“With the signing of Gorgui, we’ve added more size and depth to our frontcourt rotation,”

Travis Schlenk on Gorgui Dieng, Aug 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @JShawNBA.

item.title: Devin Booker on Gorgui Dieng
item.description:
Gina Mizell:Devin Booker on last night’s ejection:

“I’m not saying anything that was said (between him & Dieng). I keep going back to respect. Something (was) said out of line & I addressed the situation & how I feel...it’s more of an out-of-line, calling-somebody-(a)-name-type thing.”

Devin Booker on Gorgui Dieng, Jan 23, 2019. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Gorgui Dieng
item.description:
“I’m ‘Sota for life. I’ve always wanted better for not only the city and the franchise, but Wigs, KAT, those are my guys. I root for those guys. Gorgui Dieng. Those are my guys. I’m just hoping they can get through this rough patch and everybody can get on the same patch and figure it out. It’s a shit storm up there.”

Kevin Garnett on Gorgui Dieng, Oct 12, 2018. Source: The Athletic.
